**Plan, no edits made.**

The catch: "same data" splits two ways. `toTable` drops `owner` and `slow` on purpose. See [format.js:3](src/format.js:3). `buildRows` keeps all six fields.

I'd print the full `buildRows()` output, all six fields. JSON has no width limit, which was the only reason to drop them. Say the word if you want the four table columns instead.

1. Add `toJson(rows)` to [format.js](src/format.js) as `JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2)`.
2. Parse `--json` in [cli.js:9](src/cli.js:9), pick the printer, same sort order.
3. Update `USAGE` to `report [--json]`.

`buildRows` and `toTable` stay untouched.
